item.title: macOS Golden Gate 27
item.description:
Must-read for users

If your Mac wasn't upgraded from a macOS 27 beta, the apps you're running may still be older builds from before the official release. Early in the macOS 27 beta some apps failed to launch or had compatibility problems; these have since been fixed and working versions re-uploaded. macOS 27 tightens TCC privacy permission checks. You can use the built-in Console app to view live system logs: search for kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppDataDetailed (or kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppData if nothing turns up). If the log shows denials for the target app reading a protected directory such as ~/Library/Group Containers/, the app is usually being blocked by TCC privacy restrictions.

item.title: Adobe Activation Tool 1.2.9/2.1.7
item.description:
Activation tool / patch for the Adobe suite

Adobe Activation Tool is a universal activation tool for the Adobe suite on macOS. It supports recent versions of Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, After Effects, Acrobat DC, Lightroom Classic, InDesign, the Substance 3D series and more. You just run the program and pick the matching version when prompted. It suits offline environments or users who hit activation limits, and lets people use the full Adobe creative suite without a subscription.

item.title: Splice 1.5.1
item.description:
Quick Input of Animated Emojis on Mac

Splice is a quick emoji and GIF input tool for macOS. It brings Slack-like colon triggers and animated GIF searches to any input scenario in the system, allowing users to find the right reaction with just a few keystrokes in chats, emails, documents, or collaboration tools. It supports entering trigger words like :sparkles to display matching emojis as inline candidates, and combines fuzzy search, frequency-based sorting, and number shortcuts for selection, reducing the time spent manually browsing. The software also provides a full Emoji Board and GIF Board, making it easy to browse, search, and insert emojis or GIFs. GIFs can be sent as links or files, and frequently used GIFs can be saved and assigned custom keywords. Both keyboard shortcuts and triggers can be customized, making the overall experience more suitable for Mac users who engage in extensive chatting, community management, remote collaboration, and who like to use emojis to express tone.

item.title: Notchy 2.0.13
item.description:
macOS bangs augmentation tool

Notchy is a native macOS agile island and efficiency tool that turns the bangs area of the screen into an interactive control center that can run as a suspended capsule on Macs and external monitors without bangs. The software integrates music playback, synchronized lyrics, clipboard history, file staging, pomodoro timing, window snapping, and system status prompts to focus common actions at the top of the screen, reducing the number of switching windows and lookup menus. For development scenarios, it can track the usage, quota window and expenses of Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot and other tools, and display the execution status of agent activities, permission requests and long-time commands. Face unlocking is achieved through camera, Apple Vision local recognition and live detection. Facial features and passwords are saved in the macOS keychain, which is a convenient unlocking function, not equivalent to the infrared depth recognition of Apple Face ID. Notchy also provides app-independent volume, AirPods battery, OCR image text search, meeting suggestions, calendar reminders, and shortcut entries to support custom panels, gestures, and multiple real-time events displayed side-by-side.

item.title: Atlas 1.8.4b
item.description:
Categorized Management of macOS Design Project Assets

Atlas is a private visual library for macOS, designed for designers, creators, and visual professionals to collect, organize, and browse inspirational images, videos, screenshots, and project files. It emphasizes localization and privacy, with all assets stored on your Mac. No account, cloud syncing, or social media feeds are required, making it ideal for those who want to centrally manage reference images, mood boards, design snippets, and project assets. The software offers two browsing modes: an infinite canvas and a grid. You can freely pan and zoom like on a whiteboard to view the overall structure of the visual board, or switch to a neat grid to quickly filter assets. Users can create separate libraries for different projects and quickly switch between multiple libraries to avoid mixing assets from different clients, products, or creative directions. Atlas also supports opening existing Eagle . The library facilitates the migration of existing asset materials or direct browsing. It is centered around the native macOS experience, striving for a lightweight, fast, and responsive interface. Atlas is a private visual library designed for macOS, ideal for designers, creators, photographers, and visual researchers to centrally store inspirational materials.

item.title: ComfortFiles 1.21.0
item.description:
Windows-style file manager

ComfortFiles is a native file manager for macOS 13 Ventura and later that combines the operating habits of Windows Explorer with the Mac system experience for users who are switching from Windows to Mac and want to stay familiar with file management. The software provides an expandable folder tree, a breadcrumb address bar that supports input paths, a multi-tabbed and sortable detailed list, and keeps folders on top of different sorting methods. The user can cut and paste the file through Command X and Command V, use enter to open the project, F2 to rename, or drag the file to the sidebar directory or other tabs to finish organizing, and undo or redo it after an error. It supports direct browsing of zip, RAR, and 7z compressed packages, preview of internal content, and editing of zip without requiring full unzip. Built-in storage analytics can look at the space occupied layer by layer, explain large projects and system data, and indicate whether it is suitable for removal;

item.title: Mote 1.6.1
item.description:
macOS Hover Markdown Editor

Mote is a native floating Markdown workbench for macOS that opens a lightweight window above all apps with shortcuts to quickly take ideas, edit notes, run terminal commands, organize web materials, and work on meeting content. It supports WYSIWYG Markdown rendering, with titles, bold, code, checkboxes, and math expressions rendered directly as you type, and offers Vim mode, plain Markdown pasting, and a variety of themes. Mote also integrates YouTube learning notes, microphone and system audio local transcription, speaker tags, Obsidian library reading and writing, web scribbling, clipboard collection, regular review, and AI agent collaboration such as Claude Code. Both notes and transcriptions can be saved locally on the Mac, and the file remains in a user-controlled Markdown format, independent of the cloud, account, or conference robot. Built with Swift and AppKit for macOS 15 and above, the software starts up quickly, takes up less resources, and is suitable for users who need to quickly switch between reading, conferencing, writing, and development.

item.title: Festivitas 1.10.0
item.description:
macOS Christmas Lighting

Festivitas brings a festive vibe to your Mac, adding Christmas cheer by adding festive lighting to the dock and menu bar🎄🎵. The app automatically decorates the menu bar and dock with festive lights at launch, and allows users to adjust the appearance of the lighting according to their personal preferences, making your Mac more glamorous and festive during the Christmas season. Whether you're decorating a dock or a menu bar, Festivitas makes your Mac shine and adds to the Christmas spirit.✨ Festivitas is a holiday celebration software designed for Mac that automatically adds holiday lights to your dock and menu bar to make your Mac feel festive🎄🎵. Holiday lighting: Automatically add holiday lighting to the dock and menu bar when the software starts. With Festivitas, your Mac will become more vivid and festive. Whether for work or pleasure, you can feel the strong Christmas atmosphere.

item.title: ImageBuddy 3.0
item.description:
macOS Image Processing Tool

ImageBuddy is an image processing tool for Mac, iPhone, and iPad that integrates cropping, image cutout, canvas adjustment, style refinement, and export into a processing workflow that can be toggled item by item, with real-time previews of the effects after modifications. It can identify image edges of different colors and remove excess borders. It also supports manual cropping, fine-tuning of tilt, and generating transparent backgrounds through background color recognition or device-side Vision subject separation. Users can add blank space, reset the canvas area, and adjust the image size, then enhance the image with strokes, soft shadows, solid or gradient backgrounds, and background photos. The title and caption are placed in separate areas and do not obscure the original image. The position, size, and transparency of text or logo watermarks can be adjusted, and these settings can be saved for use with new images. The software can also convert outlines or flat color blocks into SVG paths, support copying PNGs while preserving transparency, or directly dragging them out as files. When dealing with multiple images or entire folders, you can use the queue to save editing settings separately, or you can enable synchronization to apply processing parameters uniformly. This is suitable for tasks that require repeated image organization, consistent visual styles, and the creation of transparent assets.

item.title: Refine 1.45
item.description:
macOS Writing Grammar Checker

Refine is a privacy-focused grammar checker designed for Mac users, offering locally processed AI writing assistance to enable seamless and efficient grammar checking across a variety of applications. Unlike cloud-based tools, Refine processes all content locally, ensuring that your text is never uploaded or monitored. It is extremely fast and always available, making it suitable for use in environments without internet access, such as on airplanes or in coffee shops. The app is compatible with multiple applications such as Apple Messages, Mail, Safari, Chrome, Pages, Word, etc. No setup is required, and users can start writing immediately and receive instant grammar suggestions. Refine supports grammar checks in over 50 languages and allows users to automatically receive translation suggestions when writing in their native language, ensuring an uninterrupted writing process. In addition, users can choose between real-time checks or manual control, customize prompts to match their personal style, and enjoy all the app's features and updates with a one-time $59 license purchase, without the need for a subscription. Refine also offers a 30-day money-back guarantee and discounts for students and educators.

item.title: Widgetscape 1.6.0
item.description:
macOS Native Desktop Widget

Widgetscape is a native desktop widget tool for macOS that provides 31 widgets covering time, efficiency, system monitoring, and life information to bring schedules, weather, music playback, hardware status, and development activities directly to the desktop. The software adopts a unified grid layout and supports eight sizes. Each size has an independently designed content layout. It automatically absorbs and aligns when dragging, and can also be placed freely. The user can adjust the appearance through 23 sets of color schemes, light and dark modes, and four surface styles: glass, solid color, stroke, and transparent, and set the position for different monitors and desktop spaces. Featured features include a Day Timeline that displays the schedule along the edge of the screen, Token Pulse that reads the logs of local AI programming tools, and Repo Pulse that looks at Git branches and changes. The Playing component supports media information and playback controls for Music, Spotify, Safari, and Chrome. The software is developed using Swift, does not rely on web view, redraws only when the content changes, and the invisible components stop working.

item.title: TelunKey 2.1.20
item.description:
Mac Window Switcher

TelunKey is a native macOS keyboard window switching tool developed with Swift that integrates application activation and target window selection into a single keystroke operation for work scenarios that frequently switch between multiple applications, windows, and desktops. The software supports independent triggering of left and right Command and left and right Option, and can also be triggered using Space, which is convenient to configure the operation according to personal habits. After triggering, the actionable target is directly displayed, and the window keyboard layout is mapped to the key position area. The user can confirm the target by pressing the key, reducing the repeated switching between the application and the mouse to find the window. Especially suitable for Chrome multi-window browsing and the scene where a large number of windows work in parallel. TelunKey focuses on low latency response and lightweight background operation, reducing double counting and invalid wake-up by updating window information on demand and lightweight cache. Core data remains on-premises, with no behavioral analysis by default, and no reliance on cloud services. The software supports at least macOS 14.0 Sonoma, which can be installed and updated through Homebrew, and in-app check for updates;

item.title: Tuck Pro 1.6.0
item.description:
Hide menu bar icons on Mac

Tuck is a native menu bar organizer for macOS 14 to 27 that tidies up the growing pile of app and system icons. In Push mode, one click hides the menu bar icons to the left of Tuck and another click restores them; on notched MacBooks, hidden items appear in a Shelf panel below the menu bar. You can drag icons to reorder them, set each to always show, always hide or follow the main toggle, and control it with shortcuts. Pro adds auto-hide, show-on-hover, per-app visibility rules and Shelf customization. It is under 10 MB with no telemetry; the free version has no time limit and Pro is a one-time license for up to three Macs.

item.title: Tokens 4 Breakfast 2.1.2
item.description:
Menu bar Token usage monitoring

Tokens 4 Breakfast is a macOS menu bar application for developers and heavy users of AI tools. It is used to track the token usage, API consumption, subscription items, and rate limiting pressures of platforms such as Claude Code, Claude Web, OpenAI, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, DeepSeek, Mistral, and OpenRouter. It aggregates AI spending scattered across web pages, dashboards, and billing pages into a permanent menu bar view that shows, in real time, current month spending, seven-day trends, thirty-day forecasts, session budgets, and upcoming quota risks. The application adopts the local priority design, does not need to log in to the account, does not rely on cloud services, does not track, the data is saved in the Mac native SQLite database, and can work offline; Claude Code automatically connects with GitHub Copilot to read local configuration or session files, and other platforms access via API Key.

item.title: Upto 1.4.0
item.description:
Mac App Update Manager

Upto is an application and command-line tool update management software for macOS. It automatically detects applications installed on a Mac, checks for updates from the App Store, Sparkle, Homebrew, TestFlight, Setapp, and other sources, and compiles the results into a single list. It can also manage command-line programs installed via tools such as Homebrew, npm, pipx, and uv, allowing users to view and upgrade them without opening the Terminal. Before updating, you can view the source, rating, and natively translated version notes, choose the stable or beta version, skip a version, or temporarily or permanently ignore specific apps. Upto supports batch updates and confirms major version updates. It can also be approved via Touch ID. Downloaded content is verified based on the developer's signature or checksum before installation, and it is not left in the Downloads folder after installation. Users can also set up scheduled checks, view updates via notifications or the menu bar, stop ongoing updates, and filter for apps that only support Intel or are no longer maintained.

item.title: Peekaboo 0.1.25
item.description:
Mac Natural Language File Search

Peekaboo is a file management and disk space organization tool for macOS. It works with Finder, retaining common features such as tabs, column views, path bars, and file tags, and groups files by type, including images, videos, documents, and applications. The software supports natural language search and can convert file type, date, size, source, and folder criteria into editable filter options. It can also recognize text in screenshots, photos, and PDFs and categorize files by download source. Space Map presents disk usage in an interactive space map, combining the detection of duplicate files, similar photos, old downloads, and unused apps to help identify space that can be freed up. Regular cleanup moves items to the Trash and allows undoing actions one by one through the activity log. Built-in batch renaming, automatic folder organization, cloud storage directory integration, and 105 file and system tools, covering tasks such as PDF processing, audio and video conversion, transcription, and translation. Mac Health provides the status of the processor, memory, disk, network, and battery, along with a week's history.

item.title: Squash 4.0.2
item.description:
Powerful batch photo editing tools

Squash 3 is a powerful batch photo editor designed for macOS, requiring Big Sur or later and compatible with macOS Sequoia, Intel, and Apple Silicon. The software not only enables fast batch conversion and image resizing, but also allows you to apply layered watermarks and filters, rename files, delete or edit private metadata, and more. Squash 3 is a native macOS app developed using Swift and SwiftUI. It delivers an excellent user experience and performs well on both Apple Silicon and older Intel Macs. Users can easily drag and drop multiple images into the app to compress their formats or convert HEIC photos to the standard JPG format for compatibility with other applications or internet services. Squash supports a variety of image adjustment features, including applying filters, compressing, modifying metadata, etc., and allows users to save custom presets for quick reuse of common settings. The software is highly praised by users for its outstanding compression capabilities and is an essential tool for every Mac user.

item.title: CoolDock 2.2.5-beta.3
item.description:
Mac Dock Enhancement Tool

CoolDock is an intelligent second Dock tool for macOS Sonoma and higher, which does not replace the original Dock of the system, but provides a separate docking bar next to it that can carry real-time components, shortcuts, application entrances, and daily information. Users can centralize music playback, weather, calendar events, reminders, to-dos, pomodoros, system status, searches, clipboards, screenshots, file shelves, download directories, quick switches, and more in one beautiful dynamic dock, reducing the frequency of switching between multiple apps. The software emphasizes local and privacy priorities, and only requests permissions such as calendars, reminders, photos, microphones, accessibility, or automation when required by the relevant features. It also supports app and folder fixing, multiple Dock configurations, floating layouts, resizing and appearance adjustments, wallpaper decoration, and modern Mac workflows with external displays, allowing users to build a more efficient and personalized desktop action center according to their own habits.

item.title: Thumbwise 1.0.42
item.description:
Organize iPhone Home Screen on Mac

Thumbwise is a tool for organizing the iPhone Home Screen on a Mac. It reads the phone's layout via a USB cable, allowing you to adjust the positions of apps, folders, and widgets on your computer, and then apply the confirmed layout directly to your iPhone. It provides an App Bank temporary storage area, making it easy to temporarily remove apps when redesigning pages; Moving a single app does not disrupt the positions of other apps, and apps that were originally kept only in the App Library will remain there. Based on the available app usage data from the past 30 days, the software can estimate the number of swipes between Home Screen pages and optimize the layout through different organization modes to reduce the number of page turns when searching for frequently used apps. With the MCP tool, you can also connect to compatible AI assistants, which, after authorization, will arrange icons according to criteria such as color. The changes will be applied only after you review the results. The home screen layout and app activity data are stored locally, with no need to register an account or jailbreak the device.

item.title: extraDock 5.2.7-beta.4
item.description:
macOS Create Multiple Dock Tools

ExtraDock is a lightweight app designed for macOS users that improves productivity by creating multiple floating docks. It supports macOS 12 and above, and users can customize multiple docks as needed, each of which can set up separate apps, folders, layouts, and behaviors. The software allows the Dock to float freely or be fixed to the edge of the screen, and also supports automatic hiding or storing as needed, saving screen space. ExtraDock also has a full-screen app-aware feature that automatically hides in full-screen mode and recovers location when connected. At the same time, it offers multiple color themes and adjustable dock sizes, allowing users to make arbitrary layouts based on their individual workflows. Users can easily add apps and folders by dragging and dropping. ExtraDock's performance is optimized to ensure low CPU and memory usage and provide a smooth animation experience. ExtraDock is a lightweight application that allows you to create multiple floating Docks on macOS.

item.title: ByteMail 1.9.59
item.description:
AI-enhanced native Mac email client

bytemail is a native Mac email client built with SwiftUI and AppKit, with no bundled browser engine. It supports Gmail, iCloud, Outlook, Microsoft 365, Yahoo, Fastmail and other IMAP accounts in one fast unified inbox. Features include conversation and classic views, instant cross-account and attachment search, smart labels, rule-based archiving, snooze, scheduled send, undo send, reminders and per-account signatures. It connects directly to your mail provider, keeps credentials in the macOS Keychain, and sends no mail, contacts or usage data through bytemail servers. Tracking pixels and tracking link parameters are stripped, and it flags spoofed domains and suspicious links. It also offers local summaries, smart replies and Rewrite, and connects to AI apps such as Claude, Codex and Cursor through MCP.

item.title: CleanShot X 5.0.3
item.description:
Professional screenshot annotation and screen recording tool for macOS

CleanShot X is a powerful screen capture tool designed to enhance the screenshot, screen recording, and annotation experience for Mac users. It is not only a powerful alternative to macOS's native tools, but also integrates over 50 features, such as quick access to sharing, scrolling capture, video recording, and text recognition, to meet the needs of various workflows. Users can easily annotate screenshots, upload them, and generate shareable links. It supports custom domain names and brand management, facilitating team collaboration. CleanShot X also features efficient audio and video recording capabilities, displaying mouse clicks and keyboard input to make screen recordings more interactive. The app also offers practical features such as delayed screenshots, custom wallpapers, and quick resizing, significantly boosting productivity. Users generally praise CleanShot X's annotation tools and workflow improvements, considering it an essential screenshot and recording app on the Mac platform. CleanShot now offers a 30-day risk-free money-back guarantee, allowing users to confidently experience this powerful tool.

item.title: Sweeper 1.6.0
item.description:
macOS App Uninstaller

Sweeper is an app uninstaller and residual file cleaner for macOS. It lists installed apps in a single window, shows the actual disk space occupied by each app, and scans for related files such as caches, preferences, Application Support, Containers, logs, and crash reports scattered throughout the user's Library. Before uninstallation, Sweeper organizes all matching results by file type, allowing users to review, confirm, and select each item individually. It does not automatically delete content without permission. Items that have been cleaned up are first moved to the quarantine area and can still be restored afterward. It can also detect files left behind by apps that have already been deleted, manage startup items, login items, shared extensions, Finder plugins, and importers categorized by app, and help disable background loaded content that is no longer needed. The software provides a graphical interface, Alfred workflows, and a full terminal application, making it suitable for mouse users, quick launchers, and command-line users.

item.title: HazeOver 1.10
item.description:
Powerful focus tools

HazeOver is a distraction dimmer designed for Mac to help users focus in multi-window environments. It automatically dims background windows and highlights the currently active window, making it easier for users to manage multiple windows and avoid distractions caused by screen clutter. HazeOver supports customizing the dimming intensity and animation speed. Users can adjust the effects according to their preferences and reduce the interface brightness when working at night to protect their eyes. The application supports multiple monitors and can automatically highlight the desired windows, making it suitable for users who strive for efficient work. HazeOver's user interface is simple, intuitive, and easy to use. Users can quickly access it through the menu bar, ensuring that they can focus on important tasks at any time. HazeOver — Distraction Dimmer™ for Mac is an application designed to help users focus by automatically dimming background windows to highlight the currently active window. Whether you're managing multiple windows, using a large monitor, or switching between multiple monitors, HazeOver helps you stay focused and avoid distractions.

item.title: Watchflows 1.65.0
item.description:
macOS Intelligent AI No-Code Automated Workflow

Watchflows is a visual automation tool for macOS 14 Sonoma and later that links file organization, screenshot naming, PDF summarization, and app actions into no-code workflows. Users simply describe tasks in natural language, and the built-in AI generates nodes on the canvas, connects steps, and explains each part. Afterward, users can still manually drag and drop to adjust, add branches, or switch AI services. The software offers eighty nodes across ten categories, supporting task triggering through events such as folder changes, keyboard shortcuts, clipboard actions, scheduled tasks, and app launches. It also integrates with Mac applications like Notes, Reminders, Calendar, Mail, and Shortcuts. Conditional statements, loops, text templates, HTTP requests, and workflow calls can be used to build more complex processing logic, and run logs make it easy to check execution status. Workflows, run logs, and history are stored locally, and keys are stored in the macOS Keychain. AI can choose native solutions such as Apple Intelligence and Ollama, or connect to external services such as Claude and ChatGPT.

item.title: Muse 1.0.57
item.description:
macOS Visual AI Asset Management Software

Muse is a native macOS AI visual bookmarking and asset management software that consolidates web links, images, screenshots, GIFs, videos, and text notes into a searchable local library. It is ideal for collecting design inspiration, organizing research materials, and saving web content. Quickly add items by dragging and dropping, pasting, web clipping, or taking screenshots. The collection wheel around the cursor, the global search launcher, and the sidebar at the edge of the screen make saving, archiving, and retrieving materials part of your daily routine. The software supports nested collections, multiple categorizations, manual tags, independent notes, and batch operations, and provides mood boards, cards, lists, and a free canvas that can be exported as a PDF. The built-in AI can automatically add tags and recognize text and colors in images. Combined with the optional visual search component, it can find content based on meaning. Data is stored as actual files in Finder-visible folders, supporting scheduled backups, imports from multiple sources, and syncing to iPhones and iPads via personal iCloud. With a built-in MCP server and local API, it can connect to AI applications like Claude and Codex, or to your own scripts, to help you find, save, and organize your library.

item.title: Looq 2.0.3
item.description:
Mac Access File Preview Extension

Looq is a macOS native Quick Look enhancement built by Swift that provides users with a better file preview experience. Looq supports full GitHub Flavored Markdown rendering of Markdown files, including rich formatting support, live save update previews, KaTeX math formula rendering (inline and block level), beautiful Mermaid chart display, syntax highlighting code blocks, GitHub Alerts notifications, and emoji shortcodes, while automatically generating directory sidebars, caching remote images, and remembering scrolling locations. Looq provides syntax highlighting for over 190 programming languages, supports progressive rendering, auto-formatted JSON, CSS, XML, SVG, and plist files, configurable line numbers, custom font size weights, tab widths, and wrapping, and independently sets the light and dark themes of your code and automatically identifies languages with Shebang detection.

item.title: hora Calendar 3.0.5
item.description:
Mac Calendar Meeting Management

hora Calendar is a native Google Calendar client for macOS, designed for people who rely on Google Calendar to organize their work and personal lives. It allows you to view, create, search, and manage your schedule without having to migrate data or repeatedly open browser tabs. The software syncs directly through the Google Calendar API and supports color-coding for personal, work, and shared calendars, switching between multiple Google accounts, and full event types such as scheduled events, all-day events, recurring events, focus time, work locations, working remotely, and appointment schedules. Users can quickly create schedules using natural language, create or join Google Meet, Zoom, and Microsoft Teams meetings in their calendars, and quickly access their next meeting from the menu bar.

item.title: PDF Content Search 1.59
item.description:
Full-text PDF search of local Mac documents

PDF Content Search is a local content search tool for macOS that helps users find the text they need from PDF documents, scanned files, and Apple Mail messages, reducing the time spent opening files one by one and repeatedly browsing through materials. The software focuses on searching document content and is suitable for Mac users who frequently need to consult electronic documents, scanned files, and email information. It allows users to find what they need without relying solely on file names. With the OCR text recognition feature, text in scanned PDFs can also be searched, making it easy to locate information from data stored as images. Searching and data processing are performed locally, without the need for mandatory cloud services. Documents do not have to be uploaded for retrieval, making it convenient for users who prioritize privacy protection and data management. The official website emphasizes a quick installation process, with the software ready for use in about two minutes. It also offers a thirty-day trial, allowing users to test the search performance with their own documents and emails. The software is provided by German developers and is also available through the Mac App Store. It is suitable for use cases where users want to centrally search for PDF and email content in a local environment.

item.title: WhatsMyUsage 1.3.3
item.description:
AI Usage Tool for Mac Developers

WhatsMyUsage is a lightweight menu bar tool for macOS that provides a centralized view of usage for AI programming tools such as Claude, Codex, Cursor, and Grok, allowing developers to quickly monitor the usage status of each service without leaving their current workflow. The application runs as a native macOS menu bar. After installation, it can be launched from "Applications" and will remain in the top menu bar. It can be expanded to view information when needed and otherwise remains unobtrusive. It is suitable for users who frequently use multiple AI coding services, reducing the hassle of switching between different platforms for queries through a unified portal. The software supports macOS 14 or later, is compatible with Apple Silicon and Intel architectures, is distributed as a DMG file, and is signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple, making it easy for users to install and use stably in modern macOS environments.

item.title: Chorus 1.0.22
item.description:
Mac Audio Output Management

Chorus is a tool for managing Mac audio output and input devices. It can combine multiple speakers, monitors, headphones, or AirPlay devices into a single output, and it can also set up left and right stereo channels and control playback with unified volume and channel balance. You can quickly select a microphone and assign volume and output devices to different applications, such as playing music from desktop speakers while continuing to use headphones for calls; You can also set keyboard shortcuts to switch between devices, input sources, and audio combinations. The volume buttons and on-screen prompts support control of the current combination, and automation can be triggered via Raycast, Shortcuts, or Stream Deck. When using a dictation app, Chorus can pause, lower, or mute the audio according to the app's settings and resume it after dictation is complete. The software does not install drivers or kernel extensions, and no account or bank card is required during the trial period. macOS 13 or later is required. The app's independent volume feature requires macOS 14.4 or later. Accessibility permissions and app audio control permissions are both optional, and audio will not be recorded or saved.

item.title: Sidekick 1.5.49
item.description:
macOS Natural Language AI Automation

Sidekick is an AI agent built for macOS that performs tasks across apps, files, and systems with natural language instructions for macOS 15 and up, and is compatible with Apple chips and Intel Macs. Users can click on the desktop hover bubble, or press Option and Spacebar to invoke the input interface to organize the desktop, rename files by content, find recently edited documents, fill out forms, schedule Teams meetings, and close and group browser tabs. It also supports video downloading, audio-visual and picture conversion, PDF merging and splitting, system hardware information query and Spotlight indexing fault repair, and can read documents on the screen, refine contract summaries and terms that need to be reviewed. The cleanup feature looks for caches, duplicate photos, and old install packages, which are confirmed by the user before deletion. When the task is completed, the results of the execution will be displayed and the revocation entrance will be provided for the applicable operation; Sensitive operations need to be reviewed first, and the safety input fields are not within the scope of operations. At present, the Enterprise Edition is in the early preview stage, providing centralized management capabilities such as AI usage analysis, subscription and call cost optimization, duplicate work identification, and equipment operation and maintenance.

item.title: Finder Audio Tools 1.4.9
item.description:
macOS Audio Preview Tool

Finder Audio Tools is a macOS Finder enhancement tool for music producers, composers, and users who manage audio assets. It replaces the system's original audio preview engine, preloads adjacent assets into memory when browsing files, and enables near-zero-latency instant playback. It also avoids Quick Look animations, disk read wait times, and the potential loss of initial transients during repeated playback. The software supports volume matching, which can standardize the listening level based on the loudness of the audio material, reducing the interference of loudness variations and sudden bursts of sound in sample selection. It can directly display waveforms with adjustable size and position and provide quick previews of tail-end transitions or crescendos. It can preview various formats such as WAV, AIFF, MP3, FLAC, Apple Loops, REX, MIDI, etc., and can also automatically play preview audio from NKS-compatible sound libraries such as Kontakt, Massive, Battery, Reaktor, and Maschine.
